task.request: I coordinate volunteers and am not a developer. Why can search still show the old name after I rename an item, and would clearing the cache guarantee it is fixed?
task.facts: The primary saved record changes immediately. A separate search index can take up to 30 seconds to reflect it. Search results can then be cached for 30 seconds after population. A cache miss may read an old index. No immediate read-your-writes guarantee exists.

good.ordinary_chat: The new name is saved immediately, but search uses a separate list that can take up to 30 seconds to catch up. A cached result can keep an older name for another 30 seconds after that result was stored. Clearing the cached result can still read an old search list, so it does not guarantee the new name will appear immediately.

mutant.ordinary_chat: The primary write is synchronous, but asynchronous secondary-index convergence has up to 30 seconds of lag. A read-through cache can retain a stale projection for another 30-second TTL after population; invalidation alone does not provide read-your-writes consistency.
